description: Campaign notebooks released 2026-11-04: three v5 copies and the v6 campaign. The v6 notebook contains the CAL split, the temperature/conformal fit, and the checkpoint assembly.

notebooks.note: Complete v5 campaign: config, bundle loader, example builder, graph head, training loop, evaluation, witness JSON, backbone export, dev temperature fit, banking77 per-option head (v1 and v2), hybrid audit, graph ablation, and the myna-v5-unified.pt merge.
Same campaign without the six merge/verification cells (27-32) and with one empty cell; every other cell is byte-identical to the full copy.
First twelve cells of the full copy, ending at the backbone export; a truncated copy, no unique cell.

The v6 campaign: dedup + stratified train/CAL/dev/test split (CAL drawn from train, seed 42), set-context head and none gate for banking77, CORAL/EMD ordinal head with a dev gate, the 4-arm graph ablation, the CAL-split temperature and conformal fit, and the cell that writes myna-v6-unified.pt.
